source.snapshotRole: Byte-preserved adopted snapshot; propose reusable changes upstream and refresh deliberately; keep Second Look deltas in project rules.

exclusionReason: Preserve executable instructions and source reference dependency closure without cross-project transcript checkpoints, private task histories, or unrelated handoff/audit material. This is a scoped snapshot, not the full upstream export.
historicalLinks: Byte-preserved master and skill may refer to upstream source notes or local installation paths. These are provenance/maintenance pointers, not dependencies supplied by this repository. Reference implementation files are examples; their old instructions never override project rules or the current master.

archiveInspection.scope: ZIP member inventory and CRC checks; common private-key, GitHub-token, OpenAI/Stripe secret and AWS-access-key pattern scan across reference files and archive members. This is a bounded check, not a comprehensive security audit.
archiveInspection.result: All ZIP CRC checks passed; no credential-pattern matches or .env/database/research-paper-corpus/node_modules/.git members found in the inspected inventory.
archiveInspection.retainedHistoricalArtifacts: Versioned archives are immutable source provenance. Full-theme acceptance, scientific approval and guide release must be assessed separately; generated teaching drafts are not consumer products.

archives.purpose: Pinned implementation provenance and reusable code; any PDF members are documented original draft or synthetic renderer proof outputs, not research-paper fulltext.
